name: Validate block markup produced by another tool before inserting it
query: Another script generated this block markup for a pricing page. Some blocks show 'unexpected or invalid content' when I open the page. Find which ones and fix the page.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Route to wp-html-to-blocks; the input contains <!-- wp: delimiters so the script runs in validate mode
Step 2: Run node skills/wp-html-to-blocks/scripts/html-to-blocks.mjs on the markup and read the Invalid section: block name, path in the tree, the validator message, expected versus actual markup
Step 3: For each invalid block, explain the mismatch (wrong tag for the heading level, missing generated class, unregistered block name)

Step 4: Do not patch comment JSON or HTML by hand; regenerate the affected sections from HTML through the converter (for example a pricing table as columns of cards plus a comparison table) and validate again
Step 5: Report any Migrated through a deprecated save() entries as harmless but note the editor will rewrite them
Step 6: Deliver markup whose report reads Invalid (0) with a stable round trip
success_criteria: Validate mode is recognised and used; no conversion is attempted on block markup
Every invalid block is named with the validator's reason
Fixes come from regenerating blocks through the registered save(), not from editing delimiters
Unregistered block names are reported as such rather than guessed into core blocks
The final run exits 0 and the fixture fixtures/pricing-table is the reference for a valid pricing section
